protocol.name: E3-advanced
protocol.generator_location: Windows host; no CPU/RAM quota; process-tree telemetry
protocol.fixture: Full stock clone (100000 rows, source columns and indexes) plus BIGINT version DEFAULT 1; fresh copy before each trial
protocol.retry: Version conflict or confirmed deadlock only; same row and increment; min(1ms * 2^k,20ms) * U(0.5,1.5); separate target/backoff RNGs
protocol.measurement: Drain warmup, then measure; stop admissions at deadline and drain all admitted operations. TPS denominator max(admission seconds,last operation completion-start). Successful latency includes all retries and backoff. No pooling of p95 across repetitions.
